visual.general_description: Three-panel study-design figure: an intensity-target schematic, a heart rate trace and an equipment drawing.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A is a step plot of intended exercise intensity over 24 minutes; panel B is a single heart rate trace with a shaded target band; panel C is a line drawing of a person in a wheelchair at an arm cycle with a phone mount. Panel letters A, B and C are printed.

panels.general_description: Step-style line plot of exercise intensity target against time for one at-home HIIT session.
panels.detailed_description: Axes: x axis Time (minutes) with ticks 0 to 24 in steps of 3; y axis Exercise Intensity Target (% Heart Rate Reserve) with ticks 0 to 100 in steps of 10. A blue solid line starts at 10 during a segment labelled Warm-up until 3 minutes, then rises to 80 for six brief plateaus (each about one minute) separated by red dashed segments dropping to 30; labels read 1 min Interval and 2 min Recovery. After the sixth interval the red dashed line stays at 30 until 21 minutes and drops to 10 through 24 minutes, labelled 5 min Cool-down.

panels.general_description: Grid of eight line plots, two columns by four rows, each showing average heart rate against time over 24 minutes with a grey band and three dashed horizontal lines.
panels.detailed_description: Each subplot has a title printed above it and axes Time (minutes) with ticks 0 to 24 in steps of 3 and Heart Rate (beats per minute) with a break mark near the bottom and a 0 tick; the y tick ranges differ between subplots. In every subplot a solid coloured line shows an undulating trace with six peaks, with a grey band around it and three horizontal dashed lines. The first three subplots (top row and left of the second row) use red lines; the other five use blue lines. Printed titles in reading order: F - T12 - 100% adherance; F - T12 - 100% adherance; F - T8 - 96% adherance; M - T12 - 100% adherance; M - T7 - 81% adherance; M - T11 - 81% adherance; M - T10 - 98% adherance; M - L4 - 38% adherance. No panel letters are printed and the subplots are not numbered.
